clarified_clauses.text_original: This policy is applicable to all employees of the company who are required to undertake business travel within India. Applicability is limited to official business travel.
clarified_clauses.text_clarified: This policy is applicable to all employees of the company who are required to undertake business travel within India. Applicability is limited to official business travel. M5/m6 grade employees are entitled to train & bus (sleeper) / shared taxi / auto for inter-city travel and auto, taxi (non-ac) for local travel. Local travel via auto is limited to <10 km; >10 km requires public/shared transport. For grade m2 employees, lodging allowance is 4000, boarding allowance is 350, and travel allowance is 150.
clarified_clauses.ambiguity_reason: [LLM-VERIFIED] The term 'official business travel' is subjective and lacks a clear definition. What constitutes 'official business' is not specified, leading to potential disputes over applicability. There is no definition of what types of travel expenses or activities qualify as 'official business'.
clarified_clauses.real_ambiguity_reason: The term 'official business travel' is not defined within the provided policy context. The policy states applicability is limited to it, but does not specify what constitutes 'official business'.
changes_made: Inserted definitions from Clause C8 and C31 to provide context for travel and allowances, though they do not define 'official business travel'.

clarified_clauses.text_original: Entitlement calculation is based on a 24-hour clock. For durations of 3 to 12 hours, 50% of the daily allowance is payable. For durations of 12 to 24 hours, 100% of the daily allowance is payable.
clarified_clauses.text_clarified: Entitlement calculation is based on a 24-hour clock. For durations of 3 to 12 hours, 50% of the daily allowance is payable. For durations of 12 to 24 hours, 100% of the daily allowance is payable.
clarified_clauses.ambiguity_reason: [LLM-VERIFIED] The clause exhibits a boundary overlap. The duration range of 12 hours is included in both the 3-12 hour bracket (50% allowance) and the 12-24 hour bracket (100% allowance). This creates ambiguity as to which allowance applies when the duration is exactly 12 hours.

clarified_clauses.text_original: IF travel duration is between 3 to 12 hours, THEN employee is entitled to 50% of their daily allowance.
clarified_clauses.text_clarified: IF travel duration is between 3 to 12 hours, THEN employee is entitled to 50% of their daily allowance.
clarified_clauses.ambiguity_reason: [LLM-VERIFIED] The clause uses '3 to 12 hours' which is ambiguous. It's unclear whether the duration includes 3 and 12 hours, or if it's strictly between those values (e.g., 3.01 to 11.99 hours). This affects policy enforcement as it's unclear which travel durations qualify for the allowance.

clarified_clauses.text_original: Travel is classified as a 'Tour' if the duration is between 1 to 15 days (inclusive). 'Deputation' is defined as travel lasting 15 days to 1 year. 'Transfer' is defined as travel exceeding 1 year in duration.
clarified_clauses.text_clarified: Travel is classified as a 'Tour' if the duration is between 1 to 15 days (inclusive). 'Deputation' is defined as travel lasting 15 days to 1 year. 'Transfer' is defined as travel exceeding 1 year in duration. If a travel duration is greater than 15 days but less than 1 year at one location, then it will be treated as deputation. During deputation, for 1-7 days of travel, benefits are as per the tour policy.
clarified_clauses.ambiguity_reason: [LLM-VERIFIED] The clause exhibits a BOUNDARY_OVERLAP ambiguity. The 'Tour' classification ends at 15 days (inclusive), while the 'Deputation' classification *starts* at 15 days. This creates ambiguity as to how travel lasting exactly 15 days is classified. It's unclear if 15 days falls into 'Tour' or 'Deputation'.

clarified_clauses.text_original: Employees MUST send a request mail for booking a ticket to reservation@ujaas.com. The request MUST be made 1 day prior to the date of travel. The travel desk will ask for travel approval via email from the supervisor/HOD before booking.

Additionally, '1 day prior' is SUBJECTIVE_LANGUAGE as it doesn't specify a cutoff time. Is it 24 hours before departure, or does it allow requests up to the last minute of the day before?
